summary_en: On November 12, the China-Pakistan Porcelain Heritage and Contemporary Art Exhibition opened in Islamabad, the capital of Pakistan. The exhibition brings together ancient Chinese porcelain and contemporary tableware that combines Chinese aesthetics with modern design, showcasing the unique charm of Chinese ceramic culture. Held to commemorate the 75th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Pakistan, it is organized by the Islamabad Museum under Pakistan's Ministry of National Heritage and Culture, and the Department of Archaeology and Museums.

title: “把发展的希望播撒在非洲乡间”（共创繁荣发展新时代）
title_en: 'Sowing the seeds of development in rural Africa' (Jointly Creating a New Era of Prosperity and Development)
summary: 本文报道中国援津巴布韦高级农业专家组在津巴布韦中马绍纳兰省津迪村建设第二个农业合作示范村。2024年以来，中方帮助打井、安装太阳能水泵、铺设输水管道，建成日供水5.5万升的灌溉系统，解决人畜饮水并保障灌溉；玉米每公顷产量从约1吨提高到5吨。
summary_en: This article reports that China's senior agricultural expert team in Zimbabwe is building a second agricultural cooperation demonstration village in Zindi Village, Mashonaland Central Province, Zimbabwe. Since 2024, China has helped drill wells, install solar water pumps and lay water pipelines, building an irrigation system with a daily water supply of 55,000 liters, ensuring drinking water for people and livestock and supporting irrigation; maize yield per hectare has increased from about 1 ton to 5 tons.
